races.name: William Hill Challenge Series Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
Making his third start back this season, EVERYSTEP OFTHEWAY ran well when second at Punchestown and he can build on that effort to go one better from what remains a handy mark. Heading the list of dangers is Mickey Cohen who arrives on the back of a win over hurdles, while Mistyburn and Knocknagoran Lady could also be in the mix.

  1. EVERYSTEP OFTHEWAY (IRE)
  2. MICKEY COHEN (IRE)
  3. MISTYBURN (IRE)

races.name: Racing TV Club Day Chase (Listed)
races.verdict:
MONTY'S STAR gave a good account in a pair of Leopardstown Grade 1s last season before stretched by the trip in the Grand National, so he could be ready to get back to winning ways at this level. He is preferred ahead of Champ Kiely who ran up to his best on last season's return, with Ile Atlantique also considered.

  1. MONTY'S STAR (IRE)
  2. CHAMP KIELY (IRE)
  3. ILE ATLANTIQUE (FR)

races.name: Connolly's RED MILLS Irish EBF Auction & Median Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
GIVE IT A CRACK has shaped with promise in this sphere and, with progress now expected, she’s fancied to open her account. Missouri Snow shaped promisingly on her hurdles debut and is feared most, while Conor’salwaysright is also respected.

  1. GIVE IT A CRACK
  2. MISSOURI SNOW (IRE)
  3. CONOR'SALWAYSRIGHT (IRE)

races.name: Horse And Jockey 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
NERIA is a well-bred filly who sets the standard on her French form and, open to improvement for her new top connections, looks the one to beat. Kenough has made the frame in both hurdle starts and, with the potential for better still firmly intact, is feared most. Maxminelli jumped none too fluently on his hurdles debut but is in excellent hands and is entitled to build on that initial experience.

  1. NERIA (FR)
  2. KENOUGH (FR)
  3. MAXMINELLI (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
MAHOLLIA was impressive when winning a Fontainebleau bumper and makes plenty of appeal on hurdles bow having since been recruited by Willie Mullins. Divaboriva sets a good standard amongst those with hurdling experience, though the drop back in trip isn't an obvious positive. Listed bumper winner Coole Cafe completes the shortlist.

  1. MAHOLLIA (FR)
  2. DIVABORIVA (IRE)
  3. COOLE CAFE (IRE)

races.name: Racing Here Again On 3rd December Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
Plenty of dead wood in this maiden, MOMENT OF GRACE selected to make a winning start for Willie Mullins having gone down narrowly in a French bumper this time last year. Malte de Solzen is another French import who has joined a top yard so he could be the one to provide most resistance, with Werner and Red Seagull another couple worth considering, too.

  1. MOMENT OF GRACE (FR)
  2. MALTE DE SOLZEN (FR)
  3. WERNER (GER)

races.name: William Hill Challenge Series Mares Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
MIGHT BE THE ONE arrives in good form and looks capable of defying her revised mark returned to this sphere. Bowgate Street is consistent at this level and is feared most, with both the progressive Dusky Night and Walk On Annilog respected.

  1. MIGHT BE THE ONE (IRE)
  2. BOWGATE STREET (IRE)
  3. DUSKY NIGHT (IRE)

races.name: Remembering Hendrix 'National Hunt' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
FORTIS ET LIBER went close on penultimate outing for Colin Bowe and having joined the all-conquering Dan Skelton yard, he's fancied to open his account at the expense of Theybouncewell, who ran a cracker on her first start of any description at Hereford last month and is entitled to progress. Arms Park, who won his bumper over C&D, looks the only other one capable of getting involved.

  1. FORTIS ET LIBER
  2. THEYBOUNCEWELL (IRE)
  3. ARMS PARK

races.name: Denise Smith Memorial Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
NOWHERENEARMILAN steps up to 3m for first time and could be worth a chance in a thin race. Makinbecon and Dublinofficecallin appeal most of those with handicap form.

  1. NOWHERENEARMILAN (IRE)
  2. MAKINBECON
  3. DUBLINOFFICECALLIN

races.name: Stag Environmental Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
COURAGEOUS STRIKE looks the class angle in here, and he's taken to resume winning ways following a breathing operation. Course specialist Taritino is feared most, ahead of Into Battle and Holeshot.

  1. COURAGEOUS STRIKE
  2. TARITINO (IRE)
  3. INTO BATTLE (IRE)

races.name: Stables Business Park Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Interesting stable-switcher ASIAN SPICE gets the call over last-time-out winner Savanna Storm. Raffles Nobu and Gone Country are others to consider in an open-looking race.

  1. ASIAN SPICE
  2. SAVANNA STORM (IRE)
  3. RAFFLES NOBU (FR)

races.name: Mike Trickey & Geoff White Memorial Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
A tricky betting race. Neither Calvino nor Tashan look rock solid so a chance is taken on TASHAN, who hasn't been long with a very capable yard.

  1. KANDOR (FR)
  2. CALVINO (IRE)
  3. TASHAN

races.name: Christmas Sparkle Charity Raceday 10 December Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
FRENCH FANCY offered something to work on when third in a slowly-run bumper at Worcester on his debut last month and could well be up to making it second time lucky. Kilifi Creek failed to meet expectations over C&D on his debut back in April but could prove a different proposition in a first-time hood. Handsome Stan also merits consideration.

  1. FRENCH FANCY (FR)
  2. KILIFI CREEK (IRE)
  3. HANDSOME STAN

races.name: PricedUp Bet 'National Hunt' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
It was encouraging COOLTOBECARELESS backed up his impressive Chepstow win with a solid third in a Grade 2 at Cheltenham just 2 weeks later and, with that form proving strong, he looks more than up to defying a penalty back in lesser company. Stars Aligning and Louxor de Grugy have both shown promise in bumpers and their pedigrees point to them doing even better over hurdles, while Keeptheflagflying is also of interest on his Rules debut.

  1. COOLTOBECARELESS (IRE)
  2. STARS ALIGNING
  3. LOUXOR DE GRUGY (FR)

races.name: PricedUp Now With Best Odds Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Not much pace on paper, which may give lightly-raced MIDNIGHT BELLA the edge over course-regular Gilbertina. Eskimo Sam also needs a look with a run under her belt.

  1. MIDNIGHT BELLA
  2. GILBERTINA
  3. ESKIMO SAM

races.name: PricedUp Boosted Prices Daily Bud Booth Mares' Chase (Listed) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
KALA CONTI advertised her well-being with a comfortable success at Down Royal on her return and Gordon Elliott's Grade 2-winning mare looks the way to go up in trip. Bluey is feared most on the back of an encouraging Aintree reappearance third.

  1. KALA CONTI (FR)
  2. BLUEY (IRE)
  3. RUBY ISLAND

races.name: Aubrey Bealby ABH Tipster Champion Novices' Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
Not the easiest race to assess but CHATTY GIRL showed some promise on her first start in this sphere at Fontwell and can build on it on the back of a breathing operation to add to her debut bumper success. The returning Ahanaglogh could emerge as the main danger for his in-form yard, with Natus Vincere and Dance Rules also worth a look.

  1. CHATTY GIRL (IRE)
  2. AHANAGLOGH (IRE)
  3. NATUS VINCERE (IRE)

races.name: PricedUp Boosts And BOG Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
DIAMOND GEEZER has shaped as though capable of defying this sort of mark and can land a fourth handicap success. Jury's In heads the dangers, with steadily-improving Frisky Whiskey also appealing in a competitive handicap.

  1. DIAMOND GEEZER (IRE)
  2. JURY'S IN (IRE)
  3. FRISKY WHISKEY

races.name: PricedUp Bet Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
JUKEBOX D'EDDY was in top form when last seen in the spring and having gone well fresh before, Tom Gretton's 7-y-o gets the nod to pick up from where he left off. Jimmyjeroo was a bit laboured at Huntingdon last month but should reapplied cheekpieces spark him back to life, he's put forward as the main threat from a reduced mark. Glengolly and Brother Boris can fight out third.

  1. JUKEBOX D'EDDY (FR)
  2. JIMMYJEROO
  3. GLENGOLLY

races.name: PricedUp Now With Best Odds Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
CAYENNE shaped better than the distance beaten suggests on his debut at Newcastle last month and it's reasonable to believe he'll last longer with that experience under his belt, making him an appealing candidate with that form already franked. Nevada Samba did well to make a winning debut at Wincanton in March considering his greenness and has to be feared under a penalty, while Monjeu de Chaillac and Micky Haller have both joined top yards after winning their sole outing in points.

  1. CAYENNE
  2. NEVADA SAMBA
  3. MONJEU DE CHAILLAC (FR)

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
BRIGHT LEGEND has fallen to a tempting mark and narrowly edges the vote over interesting last-time-out winners Cooler Than Me and Teorie.

  1. BRIGHT LEGEND (IRE)
  2. COOLER THAN ME
  3. TEORIE (IRE)

races.name: Tips For Every Race At raceday-ready.com Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
A very thin race in which HONEY JACK might be able to make a winning start over fences for the in-form Tizzard yard. Point winner Lifetime In Milan could surpass his hurdles form now chasing, with Kitsilano making most appeal of those with experience.

  1. HONEY JACK
  2. LIFETIME IN MILAN (IRE)
  3. KITSILANO (IRE)

races.name: Mark Sheasby Birthday Celebration Mares' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Ben Pauling's point winner TRUE TO MY WORD can make a winning start under Rules at the chief expense of Pure Ocean, who pulled clear with the winner on her hurdles bow back in the spring. Western Charm should be sharper for her recent hurdles debut and completes the shortlist.

  1. TRUE TO MY WORD (IRE)
  2. PURE OCEAN (IRE)
  3. WESTERN CHARM

races.name: Follow AtTheRaces On X Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
LAUGHING JOHN was in complete control when falling at the last at Bangor on chasing debut and a 4 lb higher mark shouldn't be enough to stop him making amends. Fortune Timmy and Blue Carpet have both had positive campaigns over hurdles last season and should also have a future in this sphere.

  1. LAUGHING JOHN
  2. FORTUNE TIMMY (IRE)
  3. BLUE CARPET

races.name: Get Raceday Ready Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Exciting prospect FORTHFACTOR can make it 2-2 over hurdles at the expense of Milou du Chenet.

  1. FORTHFACTOR (IRE)
  2. MILOU DU CHENET (FR)
  3. RULING PLANET (IRE)

races.name: Follow attheraces On Instagram Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Unpenalised for his decisive Fontwell success, MARHABA PRINCE looks the percentage call in a race where several have a chance. Sheezer Diva gets the nod over Rip Wheeler for next best, with Ventara potentially interesting if supported for a bang-in-form stable.

  1. MARHABA PRINCE
  2. SHEEZER DIVA (IRE)
  3. RIP WHEELER (IRE)

races.name: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap
races.verdict:
MASEGO has made a positive start for Tony Carroll, beaten only by a new stablemate at Southwell on his latest outing, and he could be ready to get back to winning ways returned to this longer trip. He gets the vote ahead of Sea of Charm, who quickly bounced back to form last week, while Stitching Wheel is interesting on her stable debut.

  1. MASEGO (IRE)
  2. SEA OF CHARM (FR)
  3. STITCHING WHEEL (IRE)

races.name: Midnite Built Different Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
MEHMAR surely has a race in him soon for Jack Jones judged on his fine run at Wolverhampton on Tuesday and his supporters can gain compensation here. Multiple C&D scorer Sir Rodneyredblood should be all the better for his reappearance last week and appeals as the chief threat ahead of Dashing Donkey and Solid Bond.

  1. MEHMAR (IRE)
  2. SIR RODNEYREDBLOOD
  3. DASHING DONKEY

races.name: Midnite Built Different Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
FOREVER NOAH wasn't seen to anything like best effect on his return at Wolverhampton and is taken to bounce back in style and bag a second C&D success now tried in new headgear. Fellow C&D scorer Henry Tudor is next on the list, although Saeculamation and Starsong can also play a prominent role.

  1. FOREVER NOAH
  2. HENRY TUDOR
  3. SAECULAMATION (IRE)

races.name: All-Weather Championship Is Back Nursery
races.verdict:
BY JOVE GRACE showed improved form when a clear-cut winner of a Musselburgh maiden in September and, having not been seen to best effect on nursery debut last time, she is taken to double her tally. Dowman is feared most as he bids for a quick-fire hat-trick, ahead of Harry's Pop.

  1. BY JOVE GRACE (IRE)
  2. DOWMAN (IRE)
  3. HARRY'S POP

races.name: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
COXY'S STAR took her form up a notch to get off the mark at Wolverhampton last month and with better to come now up and running, she's fancied to shrug off a 3 lb rise and follow up. Forbidden Colours is unlikely to live up to her price tag/pedigree but should be making her mark in this, with Overbudget rounding off the shortlist.

  1. COXY'S STAR
  2. FORBIDDEN COLOURS (IRE)
  3. OVERBUDGET (IRE)

races.name: Darley EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
An interesting novice with SPACE BOB selected to build on what was a very promising opening effort when second at Nottingham last month. Force of Light may also display above-average improvement on this second start, while Sexy is a very notable newcomer given her pedigree and sales price.

  1. SPACE BOB (IRE)
  2. FORCE OF LIGHT
  3. SEXY

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Handicap
races.verdict:
A strong-looking race for the grade with BASED taken to double his career tally with the outside stall hopefully not a hindrance for one who is often dropped in. Honey Dale seeks a quick-fire hat-trick and will doubtless be popular, with Tam Lin perhaps the pick of 4 live chances for Mick Appleby.

  1. BASED (IRE)
  2. HONEY DALE (IRE)
  3. TAM LIN (IRE)

races.name: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap
races.verdict:
DISTILLATION is back in a more suitable grade and given he looks well worth another try over 6f, he could be the answer. Freddie's Star and Insuspense (particularly if breaking on terms) head the opposition.

  1. DISTILLATION (FR)
  2. FREDDIE'S STAR (IRE)
  3. INSUSPENSE

races.name: Midnite Ain't Your Grandad's Bookie Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
This represents a pretty big drop in grade for NIZAM and representing a yard with a superb record with similar types, he could be the way to go. Kokoluna and Metallo finished first and third in a C&D handicap recently and are respected, though a bigger threat may emerge in the shape of Caledonian.

  1. NIZAM (FR)
  2. CALEDONIAN
  3. KOKOLUNA
